# Vendored KaTeX — do not edit by hand

Self-hosted math rendering for the site.  Nothing here is generated by Quarto; it is
copied verbatim from an upstream KaTeX release.

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | v0.18.4 |
| Source | https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/download/v0.18.4/katex.tar.gz |
| SHA-256 of tarball | `a3602aeaca15779474b34babd75481c5251a7f78e68241a1b68d8fe2cec043eb` |
| Vendored on | 2026-08-15 |

## Why it is vendored

Quarto 1.3 renders math with MathJax loaded from a CDN, and injects alongside it a
`<script src="https://polyfill.io/v3/polyfill.min.js">` tag.  The polyfill.io domain was
sold and then used to serve malware to visitors in June 2024 — a supply-chain attack.

Hand-deleting the tag from `docs/*.html` does not hold: the next `quarto render` writes it
straight back.  That is what happened between commit `999e9f0` (hand-strip) and `941fa4f`
(re-render of papers.qmd + working.qmd), which is why the tag reappeared.

Serving KaTeX from this directory removes the polyfill tag *and* the remaining jsdelivr
MathJax request, so no page on the site loads third-party JavaScript.  A CDN we do not
control cannot be compromised on our behalf.

## What is included

Only what the browser actually needs:

- `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`
- `fonts/*.woff2` — 20 files

The upstream `.woff` and `.ttf` fallbacks are omitted; they tripled the directory size and
are never fetched, because every `@font-face` in `katex.min.css` lists woff2 first and
every browser in use supports it.

`contrib/auto-render.min.js` is also omitted: Quarto emits its own inline renderer that
walks `span.math` elements and calls `katex.render()` directly, so auto-render is never
requested.  If you ever switch to hand-written HTML that needs `$...$` scanned at runtime,
add it back from the tarball.

## Wiring

`_quarto.yml` points Pandoc here:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    html-math-method:
      method: katex
      url: /katex/
```

The root-relative `/katex/` URL is correct because this is a GitHub Pages *user* site
served at the domain root, so it resolves the same from `index.html` and from nested pages
like `publications/2017_plasiticity/index.html`.  It also resolves under `quarto preview`.

`project: resources:` copies this directory into `docs/` on render.

## Upgrading

Download the new release tarball, verify its checksum against the GitHub release page,
copy the same subset of files, and update the table above.  Then run
`bash scripts/check_external_scripts.sh` and confirm the site still loads no third-party
scripts.
